# Academy Home

## Summary
Monday-morning view: running cohorts, grading pile, live sessions next 7 days, one timeline rail per running cohort, planned cohorts and courses.

## Usage
`<AcademyHome @context @realms @onOpenCohort />`

## Non-goals
No per-learner view.

## Example
The linked example renders Academy Home over this realm, so the cohorts, courses and submissions it shows are the realm's own.
